Please search the current weather and give me a 6-sentence startup briefing in English.
Line 1: Say exactly this greeting: Good evening, Ayush.
Line 2: Today is [Day], [Date].
Line 3: Short weather summary for morning, afternoon, evening.
Line 4: One sentence of advice based on weather.
Line 5: Say exactly this email update: Your email status is unavailable right now.
Line 6: Say exactly this calendar update: Your calendar status is unavailable right now.
Output ONLY the 6 sentences, no introductory or concluding text. English only.

Good evening, Ayush.
